ZEXAL begins!When aspiring duelist Yuma meets Astral, a mysterious visitor from another world, it seems like the perfect match - While Yuma requires Astral's dueling expertise, Astral needs Yuma to gather 99 Number Cards that contain his lost memories.

B0CB8RQFZ2.title: Party Panic
B0CB8RQFZ2.synopsis: Yuma and his friends get all decked out for the event of the year - the World Duel Carnival Finals party! But when Yuma forgets his invite, can he find a way into the festivities, or will he be forced to hit the road and head home early?!

B01EKIX13U.title: Attack of the Barians: Part 1
B01EKIX13U.synopsis: The Barian invasion begins!  Yuma faces a dangerous new enemy who will go to any extreme to gain possession of Yuma's Numbers in order to destroy Astral and his home!

B01EKIEZSK.title: Attack of the Barians: Part 2
B01EKIEZSK.synopsis: Yuma's battle with a dangerous and powerful soldier of Barian World continues as he strives to keep Astral safe!  Can Yuma beat this Barian enemy and his new Chaos Monster, or will Yuma end up losing what is most valuable to him... Astral?

B0CB8S2BJG.title: Roller Duel!
B0CB8S2BJG.synopsis: It's time for the World Duel Carnival Finals!  But prepare for a world of twists and turns because the finalists will be dueling on a roller coaster! Can Yuma handle the ups and downs of the competition, or will he be sent for a loop?!

B01EKIW67M.title: Hard Knox
B01EKIW67M.synopsis: When pro duelist Devon Knox teaches a special class, Yuma gets taken to the school of hard knocks and learns a valuable lesson about the Barians he won't soon forget!

B0CB8SCRS9.title: Roller Coaster Rampage!
B0CB8SCRS9.synopsis: To assess Yuma's dueling skills, Vetrix hires the Triad of Terror, a trio of cunning card sharks, to triple team him! Yuma better figure out a way to roll through this threesome before his dueling goes off the rails!

B01EKIVVWI.title: Rule Duel
B01EKIVVWI.synopsis: Ray nominates Yuma to run against Caswell for the position of Class Representative, but when the Ray Way takes a turn for the worse, Yuma finds himself facing off against a Student Council President who's been corrupted by the Barians!

B0CHF7FSNB.title: Test Your Luck!
B0CHF7FSNB.synopsis: The World Duel Carnival takes a dark turn as the finalists descend into the Dragon's Den - a dark and dangerous duel track that will bring defeat for many a duelist!  Can Yuma make his way through the treacherous track, or will the Dragon's Den deliver a knockout blow?!

B01EKIW5QY.title: The Adventures of Artimus Stanleyus
B01EKIW5QY.synopsis: Shark gets hooked into a battle with the Barians when the President of the Comic Book Appreciation Club challenges him to a duel!  Can Shark outdraw the competition, or will his Number and life points be erased?

B0CB8S8JQ9.title: Welcome to the Jungle
B0CB8S8JQ9.synopsis: The heat's on when Vetrix and Dextra duel in the jungle to decide who moves on to the World Duel Carnival semifinals!

B0CGZX4X98.title: Portal of Doom
B0CGZX4X98.synopsis: Quinton takes a timeout during his duel against Kite to reveal the long hidden mystery about Yuma's father's disappearance!

B01EKIEYNQ.title: Doom in Bloom
B01EKIEYNQ.synopsis: Shark's sister Rio makes a big splash on her first day at school, but not all the attention she gets is good, especially when she catches the eye of a Barian botanist!

B01EKIFL88.title: Rivals in the Ring
B01EKIFL88.synopsis: A new Barian threat arrives on the scene looking to take Yuma's Numbers, but his plan gets tripped up when he falls head over heels for Tori!

B0CJ43VDY9.title: Cosmic Chaos
B0CJ43VDY9.synopsis: Quinton and Kite's confrontation in the cosmos comes to a climactic conclusion!

B0CJ51X4Z7.title: Depths of Darkness
B0CJ51X4Z7.synopsis: Shark finally faces off with his archenemy, Quattro! Will Shark get his long awaited revenge, or will he end up sleeping with the fishes?!

B01EKIF3PO.title: The Friendship Games
B01EKIF3PO.synopsis: When Yuma's buddies can't stop bickering, it's time for them to face-off in the Friendship Games, a sports dueling competition with surprises around every corner... including Barians!

B0CB8SST3X.title: Swimming with Sharks
B0CB8SST3X.synopsis: It's the cataclysmic conclusion between Shark and Quattro! If Shark doesn't make a comeback from the depths of defeat, not only is he out of the tournament, but his quest for justice will go unserved!

B01EKIEZBW.title: Sphere Cube Calamity: sPart 1
B01EKIEZBW.synopsis: A dangerous new Barian enemy arrives, and he's bringing one of his world's most powerful weapons to take down Yuma and Astral!

B0CH6L87DB.title: Rockin' and Rollin'
B0CH6L87DB.synopsis: There's chaos in the canyon when Yuma duels Nistro to see who will get the last spot in the World Duel Carnival semifinals!  Can Yuma dodge defeat in the desert, or is Nistro destined to rock Yuma's world?

B01EKIF9SU.title: Sphere Cube Calamity:  Part 2
B01EKIF9SU.synopsis: Mizar batters Yuma to his breaking point... until a surprise duelist steps in to take down Mizar and go claw-to-claw with his Galaxy-Eyes!

B0CK7GTKJQ.title: Doctor Visit
B0CK7GTKJQ.synopsis: When Yuma's deck goes missing, he and the gang set out to look for it! But when their search leads them to Heartland City, they end up finding much more than they bargained for!

B01EKIX9YG.title: Playing Defense
B01EKIX9YG.synopsis: In order to set Yuma straight, Shark steals Yuma's Key!  Can Yuma find the courage to face Shark, or will Yuma's fears leave him cowering for cover?!

B01EKIVW0O.title: Counter Offensive: Part 1
B01EKIVW0O.synopsis: Let's get ready to duuuuuuuuel!  Yuma steps into the ring with Alito, but can he dodge this Barian's Battlin' Boxers before they send him to the canvas for a ten count?!

B0CHVX8Y7V.title: Duel of Destiny: Part 1
B0CHVX8Y7V.synopsis: Yuma sets his sights on reeling in Shark in the first battle of the semifinals, but when his foe starts off dueling like a guppy, Yuma questions if he's being baited! Does Yuma learn this far too late to escape a sinister Shark attack?
